div.head: Wl Lond 1
div.ab: Willelm kyng gret Willelm bisceop 7 Gosfregð portirefan 7 ealle þa burhwaru binnan Londone, Frencisce 7 Englisce, freondlice.
King William sends friendly greetings to Bishop William and Geoffrey the mayor, and all the burgesses within London, both French and English.
